what: Nieman Lab reports that newsletter writer Lyz Lenz, after moving from Substack to Patreon, was already about 70% of the way to what her paid subscriber rate had been at Substack within two weeks on Patreon.
verbatim_snippet: "Lenz said she is already about 70% of the way to what her paid subscriber rate had been at Substack within two weeks on the new platform."
notes: Source returned 403 on direct fetch; passage extracted from Google search index of the same URL. This is journalism reporting what a creator said (edge case 1: journalism quoting a seller = single-source article). The ~70% figure is Nieman Lab's paraphrase of Lenz, not a direct quotation. Lenz also stated via Bluesky (quoted in same article): "No one was getting my newsletter. There was no tech support." — that is a separate passage about Substack frustrations, not Patreon outcomes.
